name: ai-reset-tracker
disclaimer: Unofficial community tracker. Not affiliated with Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI, Claude, Codex, or Grok.

grok.name: Grok
grok.note: Paid SuperGrok uses an account-specific shared weekly usage pool (Settings → Usage), including redeemable banked credits (“Reset Available”) that do not replace the weekly clock. Free-tier Chat/Voice limits are separate. Public discretionary resets are sparse vs Claude/Codex — anticipator leans on sparse announcements + rival pressure.

definitions.reset: Announcement that flushed usage counters (5-hour and/or weekly).
definitions.policy: Announcement that changed limits without flushing counters; listed but not counted as a reset.
definitions.immediate: Reset applied (or propagating) without requiring the user to redeem a banked credit.
definitions.banked: Credit placed in a reset bank for the user to apply later.
definitions.unknown: Delivery mode unclear from the announcement text.
definitions.competitive_response: Reset timing aligned with a rival lab launch/promo — retention-pressure interpretation.
